caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which appears to be a rectangular lidded urn or container with a wide base and sloped, fluted sides. The base consists of several rectangular stepped layers. The box or urn has a lid that is decorated with a raised design resembling waves or flames, and is crowned by a sculpted eagle with wings partially spread, facing forward. The drawing is executed in shades of gray and black, rendering the surfaces with shading that gives the object a three-dimensional appearance. The background is plain and unadorned, emphasizing the central object with no additional elements or color.
title: Stove Urn
